bc_sweep.rationale: currents over the ranges seen during a Paci 2013 beat (I_CaL down to about -3 A/F, others below 0.5 A/F), Vm -100 to +50 mV (both sides of the -60 mV threshold of const2), Cai 1e-5 to 1e-3 mM, Ca_SR 0.05-1 mM (positive, physiological), g over [0, 1]; constants by the default factors 0.5-2.

baseline.reason: candidate: Ca-transient features of Paci 2013 (Fig. / Table of Ca-transient amplitude and durations vs the hiPSC-CM data of Ma et al.) can only be compared in an assembled cell; not applicable to this component alone.
